facts.what: Plateforme PRM (Partner Relationship Management) IA-native pour B2B SaaS. Permet recruter, activer, tracker, commissionner, et optimiser partenaires. Supports multiples types : affiliates, co-sell, influencers, referrals, Answer Engine Optimization. 600+ B2B SaaS companies. Classée #1 partner ecosystem G2.
facts.what_en: AI-native Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform for B2B SaaS. Recruit, activate, track, commission, and optimize partners. Supports multiple types: affiliates, co-sell, influencers, referrals, Answer Engine Optimization. 600+ B2B SaaS companies. #1 rated on G2.
facts.pricing_model: Tarification non détaillée publiquement ; modèle SaaS standard avec quote basé sur usage/partners.

free_tier.detail: Pas d'essai gratuit public ; pricing sur devis.

plans.name: Plan personnalisé
plans.price: Quote selon nombre de partners et use case

key_features: Tracking des leads et conversions partner-sourced
Support multiples modèles (affiliates, co-sell, referrals, etc.)
